disposition_reason: Measured gallium in wild plants and rhizosphere soil at two uncontaminated St. Petersburg sites, including leaf, root, and soil means and within-day change.

study.method: ICP-MS after nitric acid microwave digestion; plants washed and air dried to constant weight
study.basis: as reported on the source page

regulatory_or_exposure: Site 1 leaves 0.058 ± 0.010 mg/kg couch grass and 0.14 ± 0.05 mg/kg plantain, air dried; roots 1.52 ± 0.45 and 0.46 ± 0.14 mg/kg; soil 6.55 ± 0.33 and 7.32 ± 0.73 mg/kg (Table 1)
Within a day, rhizosphere soil gallium changed by about 20 percent and root gallium by more than two times
